verified: edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings (eff.edhz10.search.desc.reveal.shuffleTop; CR 113.6k, 601.2i, 701.23a, 701.24a, 401.2): when you cast it, you MAY search your library for a colorless creature card with mana value 7 or greater, reveal it, shuffle, and put that card on top (a search for a stated quality may find nothing, CR 701.23b); the cast trigger functions on the stack. The second ability (the first creature spell you cast each turn costs {2} less) is cm.t32.first.spell.each.turn.less, unchanged.

edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings 2017-11-17 (eff.edhz10.shuffle.rest.intoLibrary; CR 107.3, 113.6k, 701.20a, 701.24a): when you cast it, reveal the top X cards (X is the X paid for the spell; fewer cards than X are all revealed), you MAY put a nonland permanent card with mana value X or less from among them onto the battlefield (an Aura can't enchant the Hydra, still on the stack), then the rest are shuffled into the library (the library is shuffled even when the rest is no card); it enters with X +1/+1 counters.

edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings 2018-03-16 (eff.edhz10.search.anyNumber.totalMv; the engine search has groupLimit, effects/handlers/cards-library.ts, capability op:search.groupLimit; CR 701.23a, 701.23b, 202.3, 608.2d): when it dies you search your library for any number of creature cards whose mana values add up to 6 or less (an answer over the total is refused; none is allowed), put them onto the battlefield, then shuffle. A card with {X} in its mana cost counts as X = 0 (CR 202.3b).

edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text (eff.edhz10.search.nCards, eff.t42.putOneHand.otherGraveyard; CR 701.23a, 701.23d, 400.7, 608.2d): you search your library for two cards (no quality: both are found, if the library has them), put one of your choice into your hand and the other into your graveyard, then shuffle. The search names its cards 'looked' so the put-one-other template of Faerie Snoop reads them.

edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings 2016-07-13 (eff.t14.player.exilesTopOfLibrary, cond.if, eff.cost.cast.target.free; render/cond.ts renders the condition of a negated-type card, CR 108.1, 111.1, 608.2c, 603.2): whenever an opponent casts their first spell each turn, THAT player (the caster) exiles the top card of their library; if it is a nonland card you may cast it without paying its mana cost (as part of the resolution); otherwise it stays in exile.

edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text (eff.t30.bounce.another with sharesWith quality permanentType; CR 110.4, 205.2a, 608.2c, 603.2): whenever a nonartifact permanent you control enters, you MAY return another permanent you control that shares a permanent type with it to its owner's hand: 'another' leaves out the permanent that entered (it shares its types with itself, rules/filter.ts sharesWith.other) and the Curio; Kindred is not a permanent type. render/np.ts refuses 'shares a permanent type' unless 'another' is said.

edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings 2015-08-25 (eff.edhz10.put.anyNumber.bf.underYourControl, eff.r4dig.player.exileTop; CR 113.6k, 108.3, 110.2, 400.3): when you cast it, target opponent exiles the top four cards of their library, then you MAY put any number of land cards that player OWNS from exile onto the battlefield under your control (every land card of theirs in exile, however it was exiled; face-down cards have no types and are not lands; your own exiled cards are not theirs).

edh-zones-10 review, by hand against the Oracle text (eff.edhz10.may.putHand.unlessSameNameExiled, eff.edhz10.repeatProcess.untilHandOrSameName; the engine repeat has until and gather, effects/handlers/control.ts, capability op:repeat.until; CR 608.2c, 608.2d, 201.2): exile the top card; you may put it into your hand unless it has the same name as another card exiled this way; repeat until you put a card into your hand or you exile two cards with the same name, whichever comes first (a card with the name of an earlier one is never offered and ends the process; an empty library ends it too).
